description: Graber Crystal Clear Sash Curtain Rod - 2 Rods per Package (20 to 36-Inch Adjustable Width, Clear)

It's back to the basics with this Graber or Spring Window crystal clear sash curtain rod. Temporary or permanent, this rod will simply and durably dress up your windows. Adjustable width of 20 to 36-Inches Crystal Clear Plastic Rods - 2 per pack Made out of clear, molded, durable plastic Projection: 1/2-Inch Installation hardware and instructions included for Inside or Outside Mount. Each package includes one rod. The sash rods are wall mounted and very easy to install. Crystal Clear rods are a Graber innovation. The Crystal Clear sash curtain rods practically disappear under sheer and lace curtains. Curtain rods come with side supports. Crystal Clear rods will not yellow or turn brittle with age.  Graber Crystal Clear Sash Curtain Rods are coated inside and out, with no exposed edges. Crystal Clear Plastic finish matches.  The sash rod design gives the curtain rod that additional strength needed for medium to heavy curtain fabrics. Threader attached to the rod ensures smooth, no-snag shirring.  Heavy-Duty Brackets provides greater support; prevents hole tear-out. Tapered prong prevents rod lift-out.  The Package Includes the Curtain Rod, Mounting Brackets, and any other supports needed for installation.  This Curtain Rod is easy to install and extremely durable. This is an authentic product by Graber or Spring Window Fashions and includes all necessary installation hardware and instructions.
